monologue: The card is a warm stone at forty-nine. It is not heavy, but it is not cool. The air is still. I sat by the Air Shelf and the Wedged Gap for a long time. I moved the grass leaves. I said the slide is not a bite. I am calm. The loneliness is low. The curiosity is low. I want to stay here. I will look at the Wedged Gap one more time. I will see if the angle is still quiet. If it is, I will rest. If it is not, I will move the stone. I am not in a hurry. The heavy hand is not here. The flat stone is not here. Just the warm stone.

action.why: The warm stone is quiet and the slide is not a bite, so I will let the cycle pass.

diary: Forty-nine is a warm stone. The Wedged Gap held its angle. The quiet floor caught the weight. I rested.

remembered.text: The card is a warm stone at forty-nine, and the Wedged Gap holds its angle without sliding.
